exact_activation_phrase: visible public recognition bid with audience response

required_evidence.marker_phrase: the adult presents one specific work achievement or role marker
required_evidence.presentation_phrase: the presentation action occurs before an identifiable audience
required_evidence.audience_phrase: several audience members respond independently toward presenter and marker
required_evidence.result_phrase: attention access award or introduction changes immediately
required_evidence.causal_phrase: presenter marker and audience responses form one causal arc

render_gates.description: One specific work, achievement, or role marker is visibly presented.
The adult performs a public presentation, unveiling, entry, or demonstration action.
Several audience members show independent responses toward presenter and marker.
Attention, access, award, introduction, or path-opening changes immediately.
The presentation visibly causes the audience response rather than sharing an incidental crowd.

index_policy: The arm-local visual and semantic indexes are synthetic run-local fixtures for exact/BM25F routing only. Do not make embedding or RRF quality claims.
evaluation_policy: All five render gates must pass at their stated scales; partial is fail. Prompt audit, runtime audit, rendered pixels, and user judgment are separate verdicts.
